description: Public Print geometry contracts for per-extruder printable regions, their unprintable complements, and shared reachable area.

mutants.description: Changing the single-nozzle fallback threshold makes a one-nozzle print with one custom area return that area instead of the configured full printable bed; the dedicated single-nozzle geometry row rejects the changed bounds and area.

Replacing the common reachable region intersection with a union expands the two-overlapping-rectangle shared area from the analytic 20..80 mm overlap to the full 0..100 mm union; the independent bounds and area oracle rejects it.
